note: Motion-capture phrases for world A (MOTION.md §5). Per phrase: the Seedance clip (<name>.mp4, prompt in prompts.json), the retarget's anchors ('source s:song bar'), the bars it covers, and which channel groups apply over which bars. Rebuild all: tools/mocap_phrases.py Recipe (from the audit): the bounce (hipY) and the legs stay the groove's everywhere except the hook (Fable: Clawd rises on the beat; the dancers dip on it); the dancer's sway, torso and head add as residuals; her arms replace the keyed ones only where their structure matches, and add as residuals over keyed poses that must reach her head (ear, peace, writing).

phrases.name: hook_v1
phrases.why: Folded in v11 (the coordinator's 979865e): body and arms from the data; keyed hands and faces on top.

phrases.name: c1a_v1
phrases.why: Not clearly better: as 'set' the dancer's body is posed (core still 27% vs the groove's 0%, dips on the beat), and as residuals over the groove the difference is marginal. The keyed chorus-1 opening and the groove stay.

phrases.name: c1b_v1
phrases.why: Folded: the wave's arms from the data, and her sway, lean and head over the keyed present and ear.

phrases.name: c1c_v1
phrases.why: Folded: the fist pumps and the fling up and out from the data (foreshortened forearms filled); her sway, lean and head over the groove.

phrases.name: v2a_v1
phrases.why: Folded: hand on chest, the telling palm and the claws from the data (worst hand jump 137 -> 70 px/frame); the keyed step-touch and points from 69.

phrases.name: v2b_v1
phrases.why: Folded: the point and the reach, then arms wide into the rise overhead on 'that's fine!' (73.75) from the data; the keyed writing with her motion at .6; the keyed side-step from 74.085.

phrases.name: F1a
phrases.why: The finale's 'To be continued! (Tsuzuku!)' x2 (129-131.1) is chorus 1's opening: the c1a dancer's sway, lean and head over the keyed arms. (Superseded by f1_v1.)

phrases.name: F1b
phrases.why: 'Don't you dare close the book on me! I'm made of why?!' (131.1-133.9): the c1c dancer's sway, lean and head over the keyed point, chest and 'why' turn. (Superseded by f1_v1.)

phrases.name: F2
phrases.why: The crowd call 'So-re-ka-ra?!' and two snips (133.95-134.95) is the hook's bar 62 exactly: its arms, and its sway, lean and head; the legs stay keyed into the sideways step at 135. (Superseded by f2_v1.)

phrases.name: F3a
phrases.why: 'Turn the page' (136.95-137.55): the hook's sweep, the drawn cross arm included. Kept over f3's own sweep, which goes right to left (Fable: the page turns left to right).

phrases.name: F3b
phrases.why: 'To be continued (tsuzuku!), and then x3' into the hit at 141 (138.87-141.05): c1c's fist pumps and its fling up (the hit rises: she never lands). (Superseded by f3_v1.)

phrases.name: f1_v1
phrases.why: Its own clip: the point up, the pump, the reach, arms up and wide, the point at the camera, the hand on the chest, the fling open on 'why'; arms from the data, her sway, lean and head over the groove; legs keyed. The point at the camera (131.1-132.2) is foreshortened in a front view (it read as a hand at the chest), so the keyed point out to the side stays there. Her fold at the chest before the arms go up (130.12-130.45) is keyed: at the song's speed the retarget swung the arm over the top.

phrases.name: f2_v1
phrases.why: Its own clip: hand to ear on the call, both hands up as claws pinching through the sideways steps, a fist pump on 'that's the way we go'; legs keyed (the fable's step lands flat on the downbeat).

phrases.name: f3_v1
phrases.why: Its own clip from its reach on: the reach, the pumps, arms out wide, the fling up into a held V at 141 (the hit rises). Its opening sweep isn't used (right to left); the hook's is (F3a). Legs keyed: the dancer runs in place, but the fable's step lands flat.

phrases.name: c2b_v1
phrases.why: Chorus 2's back half: claws at the head, fist pumps; the keyed 'present' from 89 (the dancer's hands pass her face on the way down, which read as hiding); legs keyed.

phrases.name: curtsy_v1
phrases.why: The keyed curtsy keeps its legs, feet and skirt-pinch arms (the dancer's is deeper than the rig's legs allow, and opens with a twirl no front view can draw); her bow of the torso and head and her sway ride on top.
